Conditions table for tron PR #4596 (attention path stats behind the environment switch TRON_ATTN_STATS) at HEAD 04da001cb5, diff base 66c7bb8db1. Rows come from lens-coverage.json (19 lenses, where a lens is one review pass over the code for one named topic). Every file:line in the evidence column is a line a lens named as read at HEAD, plus lines I re-read with sed -n at HEAD (self_attention.hpp:485-488, 1274-1284; model.hpp:1668-1672; full.hpp:1999-2005; CMakeLists.txt:48; llama.hpp:751-753; TronCpp.hs:1317-1319; grep of .github, ci, flake.nix and t/CMakeLists.txt for TRON_ATTN_STATS returned nothing).  / Status meanings: / - checked_by_reading = a lens read the named lines and reached a conclusion. A test or run may exist in addition, and it is then named in the evidence. / - test_run_needed = only a build or a machine run can settle the item. / - not_checked = no lens read the relevant code.  / Host limits: the unit tests of the head were built and run on this host (claude-box, an AMD Zen 5 machine) with TRON_AMX_DISPATCH=ON. All 12 runs passed (buildtest.json). This host has no AMX unit (Intel matrix instruction set) and no FPGA (programmable hardware accelerator). So the AMX kernel path and the FPGA path ran only through the test fakes (fake = a stand-in object that replaces the hardware in a test). The only machine runs of real AMX code are the author's runs on delphi-3bda (the Intel Xeon CI machine that has an AMX unit) (the qwen-3-4b model, tp2 = tensor parallel over 2 accelerator cards, 8 users, prompt 1024 tokens, 256 generated tokens, USE_HW_ATTN=0 = CPU attention; PR comments 5902483127 and 5902523541). testdata-result.json found those runs arithmetically consistent with the code. They were taken from binary bff317e0d3, 33 minutes before the head commit. No FPGA-assisted run exists in this review. /  Words used here: / - forward = one model execution over the scheduled token jobs. / - token job = one token of one user's request scheduled into a forward. / - listener = the object that receives that job's logits (per-word scores). / - decode_like = every token job has a listener. prompt_or_mixed = at least one job lacks one. / - T1..T5 = the five timers, in TSC cycles (the CPU time-stamp counter): T1 forward wall time, T2 attention job time, T3 attention worker 0 job time, T4 period between operations on attention worker 0, T5 join wait. / - pool worker = a thread of the application thread pool, indexed by its pool position. attention workers = the last n_attn_workers pool workers. / - visit = one apply_page_tok call (one query slice against one KV page, a 64-token block of stored keys and values). / - path = which kernel served the visit (empty, avx, amx, fpga). / - FUSE leaf = a file under /model/<id>/attention/ served by the in-process FUSE file system (a user-space file system). / - kill switch = the environment variable TRON_AMX_DISABLE, which makes AMX report unavailable. / - TRON_AMX_DISPATCH = the CMake option that compiles the AMX kernels (default OFF, CMakeLists.txt:48). / - minibatch = one q_batch, one of the slices a forward's token jobs are split into (q_batch is the code's name for such a slice). / - chunked prefill = a long prompt processed over several forwards, one chunk per forward. / - EAGLE = a small draft model that proposes tokens for the target model. / - MoE = mixture-of-experts models (gpt-oss, mixtral, qwen-3-30b-a3b). Finding ids (R1-Mn = merged finding n of the first review round, R2-Mn = merged finding n of the second review round) refer to findings-compact.json.

C++ guide
forward_scope derives from the repo helper noncopyable<forward_scope> [attn_stats.hpp:867; h/common/util.hpp:54-60].
Every guard uses the h/common/assert.hpp macros (TRON_ASSERT_LT/LE/EQ), never <cassert>, as AGENTS.md line 73 requires [attn_stats.hpp:102, 393-395, 408-409, 432-433, 440-441, 452, 469, 556-558, 574, 580, 591; AGENTS.md:73].
Named constants carry the value suffix and uppercase style (N_PATHS_3, N_PASSES_2, PASS_READY_0, PASS_PENDING_1, N_CLASSES_2, PATH_BIT_NONE_0/AVX_1/AMX_2/FPGA_4, N_PATH_SETS_8, UNSET_CYCLES_0, WORKER_0, LEAF_READ_ONLY_TRUE, AMX_COMPILED_TRUE), and the test constants follow the same style [attn_stats.hpp:116-157; t/t_attn_stats.cpp:36-64].
Header includes match the symbols used (algorithm, atomic, cstdint, cstdio, cstdlib, cstring, iterator, memory, string, string_view, utility, vector, fmt and spdlog (the formatting and logging libraries), assert.hpp, util.hpp, fuse_stats.hpp, fuse_sysfs.hpp, system.hpp) [attn_stats.hpp:86-106]. self_attention.hpp adds <type_traits> and <utility> for the page_tok_result static_assert [self_attention.hpp:14-15, 1828-1831]. The test files already include <latch>, <future>, <chrono> and <optional> [t/heterogeneous_scheduler_compile.cpp:2-12; t/t_llama_unit.cpp:9-21].
Note [Attention path stats] follows the repo's Note [..] plus tilde-underline convention and is cross-referenced by name from model.hpp and self_attention.hpp [attn_stats.hpp:6-7; model.hpp:1658; self_attention.hpp:471, 801, 1477].
One-line brace-less ifs conform to the guide's one-physical-line exception [attn_stats.hpp:164, 165, 389, 457, 877; self_attention.hpp:1152]. New multi-line bodies in production code are braced [self_attention.hpp:630-636, 1274-1284; model.hpp:2747-2755].
is_safe_model_id rejects empty ids, leading dots, slashes, quotes, backslashes and control characters (whitelist [A-Za-z0-9-_.:]) [attn_stats.hpp:889-899; t/t_attn_stats.cpp:656-660]. register_fuse_files returns before any make_file when is_safe_model_id fails [attn_stats.hpp:918; t/t_attn_stats.cpp:661-663, 928-931].
std::vector<worker_layer_row>(n) is sized once and never grows. So the non-movable atomic elements are safe: the vector never has to move them [attn_stats.hpp:377-379].
The model_stats constructor takes std::string by value and moves it into the const member [attn_stats.hpp:365, 371].
The TRON_AMX_DISPATCH ifdef (the build-time macro that compiles the AMX kernel in) guards the AMX facts. So the CI (continuous integration) lane that is built without AMX still compiles [self_attention.hpp:485-488].
The single-writer atomics scheme with relaxed memory order (the weakest C++ ordering: each access is atomic, but no ordering with other memory accesses is promised) is documented in the header [attn_stats.hpp:176-192]. It holds per row. add_visits, note_attn_job and note_join_wait are keyed by the pool worker that runs the job [self_attention.hpp:855, 1342-1343, 1484-1486]. Main-thread counters use relaxed fetch_add [attn_stats.hpp:535-536, 543-544, 575, 581-584, 593]. Readers load relaxed [attn_stats.hpp:604-624].

is_safe_model_id rejects empty ids, leading dots, slashes, quotes, backslashes and control characters (whitelist [A-Za-z0-9-_.:]) [attn_stats.hpp:889-899; t/t_attn_stats.cpp:656-660]. register_fuse_files returns before any make_file when is_safe_model_id fails [attn_stats.hpp:918; t/t_attn_stats.cpp:661-663, 928-931].
std::vector<worker_layer_row>(n) is sized once and never grows. So the non-movable atomic elements are safe: the vector never has to move them [attn_stats.hpp:377-379].
The model_stats constructor takes std::string by value and moves it into the const member [attn_stats.hpp:365, 371].
The TRON_AMX_DISPATCH ifdef (the build-time macro that compiles the AMX kernel in) guards the AMX facts. So the CI (continuous integration) lane that is built without AMX still compiles [self_attention.hpp:485-488].
The single-writer atomics scheme with relaxed memory order (the weakest C++ ordering: each access is atomic, but no ordering with other memory accesses is promised) is documented in the header [attn_stats.hpp:176-192]. It holds per row. add_visits, note_attn_job and note_join_wait are keyed by the pool worker that runs the job [self_attention.hpp:855, 1342-1343, 1484-1486]. Main-thread counters use relaxed fetch_add [attn_stats.hpp:535-536, 543-544, 575, 581-584, 593]. Readers load relaxed [attn_stats.hpp:604-624].
